item.title: Hello, World
item.description:
Welcome to Ralph’s Kitchen — a place for writing about food, cooking, and whatever else deserves a longer thought than a tweet.

Why a blog?

Some things need space. A good stock takes hours. A good meal deserves reflection. A blog feels right.

What to expect

Posts here will probably cover:

  • Recipes I’ve actually made and liked
  • Techniques worth understanding
  • The occasional digression into kitchen tools

No algorithms, no ads, no newsletter popups. Just writing.
